headline: Waist-high ESE at dawn with light wind — worth an early paddle.
today: Best window is the dawn patrol while the wind is light out of the W and the ESE swell is clean. It softens as ESE cross-on fills in mid-morning and goes onshore S by afternoon. Nothing huge but a fun little log or fish session if you're out early.

daysToWatch.note: Big numbers on paper — up to 4.7ft S prime angle — but onshore 19mph at dawn dropping to 13. Sizey and messy; only worth it if you like a challenge.
The pick of the week. 3.1-3.7ft SSE prime angle with light wind at dawn and morning — glassy and solid. Be there early on the shortboard before the S cross-on comes up afternoon.
Still 3.4-3.7ft prime angle with NE cross-off, though wind is a stiff 17mph. Decent size, groom-able early.
2-3ft prime angle with NE cross-off going light by morning. Another clean fun one on the shortboard.
